name: Takeling
gmNotes: A Takeling is biologically Human — a Human taken in infancy and raised by the Fey. Takeling is a provenance archetype, not a Species, and a Takeling is not Fey. Takelings often fill Fey-trained roles (such as Leannán Sidhe), but this archetype records only where the person was raised. Archetypes are descriptive and grant no automatic mechanics.
description: A human taken in infancy and raised among the Fey. Takelings grow up in the hollow hills, learning the Fair Folk's speech, courtesy, and ways, and they are rarely fully at home in either world afterward. The village sees them as strange; the Fey see them as useful.
